terminals.name: jupyter-lab
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run --locked jupyter lab --no-browser --port 8888 --ip 0.0.0.0 --ServerApp.token="" --ServerApp.password=""
terminals.description: Jupyter Lab with root project dependencies. Open http://localhost:8888/lab inside the isolated Cloud Agent environment. Nested projects and specialized notebooks need their documented extra setup. Live API cells need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (and sometimes VOYAGE_API_KEY or other service credentials) as environment secrets.
